ResetLinkInvalid.zh-TW: 連結已失效或已使用過，請重新申請
ResetLinkInvalid.en-US: The link has expired or has already been used. Please request a new one
ResetLinkInvalid.th: ลิงก์หมดอายุหรือถูกใช้ไปแล้ว โปรดขอใหม่
ResetLinkInvalid.vi: Liên kết đã hết hạn hoặc đã được sử dụng, vui lòng yêu cầu lại

ResetLinkUnavailable.zh-TW: 這個帳號已停用或沒有已驗證的 Email，不能寄重設連結，請改設暫時密碼
ResetLinkUnavailable.en-US: This account is disabled or has no verified email, so a reset link cannot be sent. Set a temporary password instead
ResetLinkUnavailable.th: บัญชีนี้ถูกปิดใช้งานหรือไม่มีอีเมลที่ยืนยันแล้ว จึงส่งลิงก์รีเซ็ตไม่ได้ โปรดตั้งรหัสผ่านชั่วคราวแทน
ResetLinkUnavailable.vi: Tài khoản này đã bị vô hiệu hóa hoặc chưa có email đã xác minh nên không gửi được liên kết đặt lại, hãy đặt mật khẩu tạm thời

ResetLinkTooSoon.zh-TW: 重設連結剛寄過，請 {0} 秒後再試
ResetLinkTooSoon.en-US: A reset link was just sent. Try again in {0} seconds
ResetLinkTooSoon.th: เพิ่งส่งลิงก์รีเซ็ตไป โปรดลองใหม่ใน {0} วินาที
ResetLinkTooSoon.vi: Vừa gửi liên kết đặt lại, vui lòng thử lại sau {0} giây

ResetLinkUseChangePassword.zh-TW: 自己的密碼請用「變更密碼」
ResetLinkUseChangePassword.en-US: To change your own password, use Change password
ResetLinkUseChangePassword.th: หากต้องการเปลี่ยนรหัสผ่านของคุณเอง โปรดใช้ "เปลี่ยนรหัสผ่าน"
ResetLinkUseChangePassword.vi: Để đổi mật khẩu của chính bạn, hãy dùng "Đổi mật khẩu"

ResetLinkDemoRestricted.zh-TW: Demo 站只有 mfa01 可示範重設密碼
ResetLinkDemoRestricted.en-US: On the demo site, only mfa01 can be used to demonstrate password reset
ResetLinkDemoRestricted.th: ในไซต์เดโม ใช้ได้เฉพาะ mfa01 เพื่อสาธิตการรีเซ็ตรหัสผ่าน
ResetLinkDemoRestricted.vi: Trên trang demo, chỉ mfa01 dùng được để minh họa đặt lại mật khẩu

ResetLinkMailUnavailable.zh-TW: 系統目前寄不出信（寄信設定或站台網址還沒設好），不能寄重設連結，請改設暫時密碼
ResetLinkMailUnavailable.en-US: The system cannot send email right now (email settings or the site URL are not set up), so a reset link cannot be sent. Set a temporary password instead
ResetLinkMailUnavailable.th: ขณะนี้ระบบส่งอีเมลไม่ได้ (ยังไม่ได้ตั้งค่าอีเมลหรือ URL ของไซต์) จึงส่งลิงก์รีเซ็ตไม่ได้ โปรดตั้งรหัสผ่านชั่วคราวแทน
ResetLinkMailUnavailable.vi: Hệ thống hiện không gửi được email (chưa thiết lập cài đặt email hoặc URL trang) nên không gửi được liên kết đặt lại, hãy đặt mật khẩu tạm thời

ResetLinkDemoAccount.zh-TW: 示範帳號不能寄重設連結
ResetLinkDemoAccount.en-US: Reset links cannot be sent to demo accounts
ResetLinkDemoAccount.th: ส่งลิงก์รีเซ็ตให้บัญชีเดโมไม่ได้
ResetLinkDemoAccount.vi: Không thể gửi liên kết đặt lại cho tài khoản demo
